name: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake
description:
Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake I
Challenge a Revived Primo Geovishap that constantly changes Elemental Type.
Even in its long dreams, it would constantly draw energy from the ley lines, perhaps waiting for the day to come when it could rise to meet the sun once more and unleash its long-festering fury, shattering rocks and tearing mountains asunder.
Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake II
Challenge a Revived Primo Geovishap that constantly changes Elemental Type.
